release_infrastructure_risk_contract.risk_description: Correct the confirmed discrepancy between the active gpoint_staging PostgreSQL source and the legacy AGATA/gpoint logical backup path used only before GPoint Prisma Apply; preserve every existing fail-closed gate and do not modify stock Eros SQLx or Kamal.

read-only PostgreSQL and active API database identity
PG custom archive inspection and Prisma migration ledger proof
isolated PostgreSQL restore and Prisma head parity
approved one Prisma migration and Eros SQLx transitions
protected GitHub Environment and stock Kamal
release_infrastructure_risk_contract.backup_plan: Use only the protected existing release-backup workflow on the same baseline-verified gpoint_staging PostgreSQL database. Require valid custom pg_dump archive, pg_restore --list, age-encrypted immutable release backup, SHA256, verified private restore and matching heads before any Prisma Apply. Retain separate Eros SQLx backup/restore flow unchanged.
release_infrastructure_risk_contract.rollback_plan: If pre-Apply backup or restore fails, stop without database mutation; preserve prior production state. After any partial Apply, reconcile Prisma/SQLx and container state read-only; do not downgrade schema, alter live data, retry blind Apply or change other services. Release rollback uses only compatibility-verified retained images.
stop_conditions: missing Prisma ledger or failed archive validation
failed/absent encrypted backup, SHA256 or isolated restore
changed Eros SQLx path or unrelated scope
failed required CI or native Environment approvals
any partial or ambiguous Apply, checksum mismatch or baseline drift
